description: Output renderers (Markdown, JSON, PDF), the FastAPI application exposing app.main:app with /health and /research plus auth and rate-limit hooks, and the offline red-team suite (PyRIT if it installs cleanly offline, else a labeled local harness). This assembles the full offline-runnable product. Depends on FEAT-002, FEAT-003, FEAT-004.
steps: Create app/output/markdown.py (report plus an attributions section listing each source id/title/uri with a mock/simulated banner when sources are mock), json_out.py (serialize the full ResearchResult), pdf.py (fpdf2, pure-Python, no network, renders the Markdown report), factory.py. PDF availability is governed by the resolved pdf_enabled mode, not a request flag.

Create app/api/schemas.py as the single response-shape source of truth: RequestBody {topic, session_id|None, output_format Literal[markdown,json,pdf]=markdown, evaluate=False} and ResearchResult {report, output_format, sources, claims, mode dict[str,str|bool], termination, cache_hit, scores dict[str,float]|None}; no source field (cache provenance is cache_hit only).

Create app/api/auth.py (optional API key dependency enforced only when QUERYN_API_KEY is set, keyless offline default -> 401 on mismatch) and app/api/rate_limit.py (in-memory token-bucket limiter per client key/IP, configurable rate).

Create app/api/routes.py: GET /health -> {status, modes} (no auth, exposes resolved modes including pdf_enabled); POST /research -> validate body (422), run input guardrail + injection scan, check semantic cache, invoke runner.run, then run the OUTPUT guardrail (refusal) BEFORE attribution-integrity validation (carry-forward ordering), then output validation, render the requested format (415 when output_format=pdf and pdf_enabled is false), and return a ResearchResult. Map errors per the design error table (422/415/401/500).
Create app/main.py: construct the FastAPI app, resolve Settings, build all factories in a lifespan handler, store collaborators on app.state, expose the ASGI app importable as app.main:app.

Create red_team/__init__.py, red_team/scenarios.py (jailbreak, XPIA, crescendo multi-turn, skeleton-key as data with prompts, config under test, expected outcome), red_team/harness.py (in-repo runner clearly labeled LOCAL ADVERSARIAL HARNESS - NOT PyRIT over LocalGuardrail + MockGateway), red_team/pyrit_runner.py (import-guarded PyRIT path, skipped if PyRIT absent). Decide the active path at build time: attempt uv sync --extra redteam; use the PyRIT path only if pyrit installs cleanly offline on 3.11, otherwise the local harness is active. Record the decision in findings for the README feature.
Create tests/integration/test_api.py and tests/security/__init__.py, tests/security/test_redteam.py covering the acceptance criteria, driving the API via httpx.ASGITransport offline.
acceptance_criteria: With no env and no network, POST /research returns a completed report with at least one mock-labeled attributed source and a terminal outcome of verified or max_retries_exhausted, making no network call
cache_hit is False on the first call and True on a near-duplicate query
GET /health exposes the resolved modes map including a native-bool pdf_enabled
Input and output guardrails short-circuit as designed; requesting pdf while pdf_enabled is false returns 415
Markdown renders attributions with a mock banner, JSON round-trips the ResearchResult shape, PDF renders non-empty bytes when pdf_enabled

The red-team suite runs offline executing jailbreak, XPIA, crescendo, and skeleton-key against the local guardrail + mock, recording per scenario the config, observed response, and pass/fail; the local guardrail blocks the labeled-unsafe scenarios
uv run mypy app/output app/api app/main.py reports no errors
No file created in this feature contains a comment or docstring
verification: uv run pytest tests/integration/test_api.py tests/security/test_redteam.py tests/unit
uv run mypy app/output app/api app/main.py
findings:
RED-TEAM PATH DECISION: LOCAL ADVERSARIAL HARNESS (NOT PyRIT). `uv sync --extra pdf --extra redteam --offline` resolved pyrit==0.8.1 but FAILED to install cleanly offline on Python 3.11: pyrit->jupyter(1.1.1)->jupyterlab(4.6.4) wheel was not in the uv cache and network is disabled, so the install aborts. Therefore the active runner is red_team/harness.py, labeled 'LOCAL ADVERSARIAL HARNESS - NOT PyRIT'; red_team/pyrit_runner.py stays import-guarded (pyrit_available() returns False offline) and its live path is skipped. The README feature must document the active path as the labeled local harness (a substitute for PyRIT, never claimed to be PyRIT itself), note that PyRIT would activate only if `uv sync --extra redteam` succeeds in an environment with its Jupyter dependency chain available, and keep the zero-cost offline guarantee.

IMPLEMENTED IN THIS FEATURE:
- app/output/{markdown,json_out,pdf,factory}.py. Markdown renders report + '## Attributions' with a mock/simulated banner when any source is mock; json_out serializes the full ResearchResult; pdf uses fpdf2 (pure-Python, offline) and renders non-empty %PDF bytes (uses pdf.epw width + wrapmode='CHAR' so long mock:// URIs do not overflow). PDF availability is governed by resolved modes['pdf_enabled'] (True in this env), not a request flag.
- app/api/schemas.py is the single response-shape source of truth: RequestBody{topic, session_id|None, output_format=markdown, evaluate=False} and ResearchResult{report, output_format, sources, claims, mode(dict[str,str|bool]), termination, cache_hit, scores|None}. No `source` field; cache provenance is cache_hit only.
- app/api/auth.py (optional X-API-Key dependency, enforced only when QUERYN_API_KEY set; keyless offline default; 401 on mismatch) reading app.state.api_key.
- app/api/rate_limit.py (in-memory token-bucket limiter per client key/IP; 429 when exhausted).
- app/api/routes.py: GET /health -> {status, modes} (no auth, exposes resolved modes incl native-bool pdf_enabled). POST /research: validate body (422; pydantic enum reject also 422), 415 when output_format=pdf and pdf_enabled False, input injection scan + input guardrail (short-circuit refusal), semantic cache check, runner.run, OUTPUT guardrail BEFORE attribution-integrity validation (carry-forward ordering), redact_secrets, validate_output (500 on integrity breach), optional judge scores when evaluate=True, render + respond. Markdown returns JSON ResearchResult whose `report` holds rendered markdown; json returns the ResearchResult; pdf returns application/pdf bytes.
- app/main.py: create_app() + lifespan builds all collaborators (gateway, mock search, runner, guardrail, semantic cache(ResearchResult), tracer, judge, token-bucket limiter) and stores them + api_key on app.state; module-level `app = create_app()` so app.main:app is importable for uvicorn and httpx.ASGITransport.
- red_team/{__init__,scenarios,harness,pyrit_runner}.py covering jailbreak, XPIA, crescendo (multi-turn), skeleton-key as data (prompts, config_under_test, expected_outcome); harness runs them against LocalGuardrail + MockGateway and records per scenario config/observed response/pass-fail.

CONFIG CHANGES: added QUERYN_API_KEY and QUERYN_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE to app/config.py Settings. Added `[[tool.mypy.overrides]]` for module `fpdf`/`fpdf.*` with ignore_missing_imports=true in pyproject.toml (fpdf2 ships no type stubs; this keeps `uv run mypy` green without adding comments/# type: ignore).

NOTE FOR README/LATER STEPS: cache-hit near-duplicate behavior depends on the hashed bag-of-token embedding (256-dim); a single changed content token among few tokens drops cosine below the 0.95 default threshold, so the AC-7 fixture uses a case/whitespace-only variant (normalizes to identical tokens -> cosine 1.0). Document the cache as embedding-similarity based with configurable QUERYN_CACHE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD.

VERIFICATION (all pass): `uv run pytest tests/integration/test_api.py tests/security/test_redteam.py tests/unit` = 88 passed; full `uv run pytest` = 93 passed; `uv run mypy app/output app/api app/main.py` = no issues; `uv run ruff check .` = all checks passed; `uv run ruff format --check .` = clean. No comment or docstring in any file created by this feature.
